name: Liberation
type_description: Ring modulator / VCO with 4046 PLL and stepped tone generator
schematic_evidence: Page states 'A schematic image and downloadable PDF are provided'; the PDF itself returned no extractable/machine-readable text on fetch, so reference designators, net labels or part values inside it could not be confirmed directly.
bom_where: table on page (also linked as 'Liberation v1 PDF' download, same file as schematic)
components_evidence: Page's BOM lists part types only (resistors, capacitors, transistors, CD4046, LM556, TL072, TL074 ICs, potentiometers, switches, jacks) with no package/mounting-type info (no 0805/DIP/SOIC/TO-92/'through-hole'/'SMD' wording); PDF yielded no extractable text to check further.

lineage.credit: Based loosely on the Moog Liberation 'ring mod' implementation of the 4046 CMOS PLL chip.
lineage.quote: Based loosely on the Moog Liberation 'ring mod' implementation of the 4046 CMOS PLL chip

lineage.credit: one of these awesome modules by Barton Musical Circuits
lineage.quote: one of these awesome modules by Barton Musical Circuits; also references a PLL Synthesizer Cookbook found secondhand

notes: Page confirms lineage to Barton Musical Circuits (links bartonmusicalcircuits.com/4046/documentation.pdf) but never uses the terms 'BMC33' or 'Wave Shaper' verbatim, so that specific module-name claim is unconfirmed, only the designer/chip lineage. Filename suggests 'v1' but no version text found on page.
